slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell to 7,765.36, down 0.47%, while the Nasdaq 100 dropped 1.34% as chip and AI stocks led the decline. The trigger was a report that OpenAI's actual revenue came in well below what investors had expected, which raised fresh doubts about whether the massive spending on AI hardware can be justified. Oil jumped 3.18% on renewed tanker attacks near the Middle East, which pushed energy stocks higher and added to inflation worries. Tomorrow brings the preliminary University of Michigan consumer sentiment reading, which will give a read on how worried ordinary Americans are about prices.
